params.val: boosts Ice-type Defense by 50%; deals no per-turn chip damage

verified against Showdown source (conditions.ts snowscape, the Gen 9 condition replacing legacy Hail): modern Snow has onModifyDef (+50% Def for Ice-types) and NO onWeather damage call, unlike legacy Hail (data/conditions.ts hail: this.damage(baseMaxhp/16) to non-Ice-types). Per this project's modern-mainline-always rule, the per-turn chip damage was removed and the previous hedge ("pick one behavior") was resolved in favor of Snow's no-damage behavior.
